tool_args.rationale: A high-s_grad probe can distinguish the recalled sink mechanism from a critical-gradient branch before fitting and confirming a quantitative law.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the hydraulic sink model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows confound u_now with s_grad and do not establish whether a high-gradient branch term is present.
The target is already observed at the forecast horizon; resolving the gradient regime is more directly relevant.
